_comment: Where the private vault lives on this machine. A string, or a per-OS map (nt / posix). EVERLAST_VAULT in the environment overrides. A Windows drive path is ignored on Mac and Linux.
_comment_stale: Check before use: days from an entry's `verified` date to its `stale_after` date, by kind. An entry past it shows (recheck due) in INDEX.md and at session start.
